---

## Problem

What are you trying to accomplish that TYJ doesn't currently support?

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you've thought about, and why they don't work as well.

## Additional Context

Mockups, screenshots, or related issues.

> **Note:** TYJ is offline-first and privacy-focused — features that require a backend (auth, sync, email) are tracked on the project roadmap and may be scoped differently.
